text_block_list.text: While passing by the dance studio―――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three!
From right hand to~ left hand? And then~,
umm...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Cross my legs... and—!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaa~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yup, yup! What a magnificent tumble!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, Teio-san...!
I've gone and shown you such an embarrassing display!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I saw the whole thing!
You're practicing dance for the Winning Live, right~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! If it's dance you need help with,
just ask the invincible dance master—me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really okay?!
Teio-san... no, Teio-sensei!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, Spe-kun!
Now, watch my steps closely!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Up to here is, yep! Simple, right?
And here, where Spe-chan is having trouble, goes...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Like, pyah, pwee, pyoooing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Pyah, pwee, pyoooing...!
Understood, I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Pyah...! Pwee...!
Pyoooing...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's just a liiittle bit off.
At the "pyah" part, make it more like "byao!"!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Byao!! ...Fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, your instructions are just so whimsical,
I couldn't help having fun...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehh, really~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, they do say geniuses have a unique style!

While laughing at the peculiar coaching, Special Week
still seemed to be struggling with her dance lessons.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It's really fun, but
my clumsiness just won't go away, desu ne.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm still so inexperienced when it comes to running too...
No matter how much I run, it never feels like enough.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If I want to become the best in Japan,
I have to work much, much harder.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So, dance practice is really fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow, it feels like I'm taking a detour.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey, hey! Spe-chan!
Do you know why we do Winning Lives?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eh... um, come to think of it, why do we?
Races are our primary goal, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fuffun! I know the answer!
Though Kaicho gave me a hint!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aaaand the reason iiiis~~~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now now, Teio.
"Meaning" is something one must comprehend for oneself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Kaicho!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Special Week.
Self-reflection is a crucial virtue.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ponder within your heart
the true reason behind performing Winning Lives.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
President-san...!
Understood, I'll think about it!
